messages:
maria (partnerships): Hey @laura, for the cost-model we need your tiered rebate curves + eviction profiles as a CSV by EOD Thu. Key things: reserved vs spot prices, commit sizes, and eviction probability by hour. Can you confirm?
laura (voltcloud): Hi Maria — yes we can provide. Quick Q: do you want spot reported as per-hour instantaneous or a 30-day rolling avg? And rebate tiers as % or USD credits?
ajay (finance): per-hour instantaneous is best for modeling burst vs steady. For rebate tiers, USD/hour works better for our unit economics. Also include any one-off signup credits. :memo:
devon (ops): + please include preemption notice window (mins) and any scheduled maintenance blackout windows per region. Those change eviction timing assumptions.
maria (partnerships): Agreed. Suggested CSV header to save time:
```
sku,region,spot_hourly_usd,reserved_hourly_usd,commit_hours,eviction_prob_per_hour,preempt_notice_mins,blackout_hours_per_month,min_avail_pct,billing_lag_days,rebate_usd_per_hour,one_off_credit_usd,commit_flex
```
laura (voltcloud): OK sample below — will produce full set for all SKUs.
```
VC-GPU-A,us-west,0.85,0.55,720,0.002,30,2,0.82,14,0.10,0,TRUE
VC-GPU-B,us-east,0.95,0.60,720,0.008,15,4,0.76,7,0.12,1000,FALSE
```
maria (partnerships): Perfect. We'll run sensitivity on commit tenor (1m/3m/12m) and eviction tail (median vs 95pct). Also please include any regional capacity ramp dates if you have them.
vendor-bot: Upload received: s3://redwood-internal/partner-feeds/voltcloud/1723141592_v1.csv — validating... errors: none. Parsed 18 SKUs. :white_check_mark:
ajay (finance): Quick ask — add columns median_spot and p95_spot if you can. If not, we'll compute from the per-hour feed but it's helpful to have.
laura (voltcloud): Can add median/p95. Uploading v2 in ~10m with commit_flex and median/p95 fields.
maria (partnerships): Also add a free-text "notes" column for special promos or one-off trial windows.
raman (pricing): FYI — if eviction_prob_per_hour > 0.1 in any hourly bucket, we'll cap reserved conversion at 60% in the model. Share any data on multi-hour correlated evictions if available.
devon (ops): And include maintenance blackout windows as RFC ranges (e.g., 2026-04-01..2026-04-03) if you plan regional infra work — helps us model short-term supply dips.
laura (voltcloud): Noted. V2 will contain: median_spot,p95_spot,commit_flex,notes,planned_ramp_dates. Uploading now.
vendor-bot: Upload received: s3://redwood-internal/partner-feeds/voltcloud/1723141592_v2.csv — validating... warnings: 2 SKUs missing p95_spot (using rolling-30d fallback). Parsed 24 SKUs.
maria (partnerships): Thanks @laura and @vendor-bot. We'll ingest v2 and run initial cost sheet by Fri noon. Ping if you want to join the model walkthrough. :calendar: 
ajay (finance): I'll slot time Fri 11am for a quick review.
laura (voltcloud): I'll join. Also open to a short tech sync on how you ingest the CSV so we can automate.
raman (pricing): Heads-up: if commit_flex == TRUE we apply a 20% early-exit penalty in the pricing model unless you provide a penalty schedule column.
maria (partnerships): Good catch. @laura can you add "exit_penalty_pct" if available.
laura (voltcloud): Will include exit_penalty_pct in v3 if needed after you ingest v2.
maria (partnerships): Great — thanks everyone."
